title: PathPilotAudioAnalyseResponse
description: API response schema for POST /api/v1/audio/analyse in PathPilot.

is_mock.description: True if payload was generated by mock fixtures or testing stubs.

model_version.description: Identifier of the acoustic cue model, e.g., 'v1.0.0-compact-cnn'.

detected_cues.description: List of detected acoustic sound cues exceeding confidence threshold.

requires_user_confirmation.description: MANDATORY SAFETY INVARIANT: Always true. The client application must explicitly prompt the user for confirmation before initiating any further action.

limitations.description: Explicit caveats regarding model accuracy, scope, and lack of danger declaration.

warnings.description: Operational warnings (e.g. low SNR, high uncertainty, clipping).
